notes.title: Update: More events added, new entrance fee system
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/3878cec88ba39a37b1705909f189119fd934673f.png
Hello, community!

Is there a point in apologizing for being silent if you won't forget us monsters anyway? Yeah, we think so too. Anyway, despite of how foul we are we are finally bringing you this substantial update. Details below:
v.0.9.014.a
 New random (and crazy, of course) party events for you to handle. Talk about unexpected stuff.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/c2514dc3a980b537197db8bc6e1560b9b876a9e7.jpg

 Entrance fee system was reworked and optimized. We have received a lot of the feedback from you guys about the old system being obscure and unintuitive at times. Now the bigger the price, the less people will come, simple as that. Easier to control your audience and to make profit at bigger locations.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/88d67638880df6f369f802275b662b1afedbaf1d.png

 Party disappointment system underwent changes. We addressed a number of bugs and also made it more clear why partygoers were disappointed at times. In addition, a number of visitors who started to felt disappointed—and therefore left—was decreased.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/4135af88c5a572ebe195da065f30be73a1872c25.png

 Installed furniture icons now remain visible all the time. 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/adcdb1403e3c9ad3531abf39da8f7a2265d6d63b.png
 Table descriptions were simplified. Profit per person is now indicated clearly as well as capacity. Also, serving the table now costs 30% of its total value. 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/459c8bf4b2dc0b3070ca3369415d9c073fd78f1d.jpg
 Arcade cabinet was added as an early game green grade equipment. Gamer party theme now works better. Arcade cabinets don't need to be refilled. 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/ddc80233f743796889992804a92b4af191da0cb7.png
 Fixed high grade characters unlocking on early stages on the game
 Fixed toilets
 Fixed janitors
 Fixed quests based on the old Hype system
 Fixed calendar day modifiers based on the old Hype system
 Fixed fans not coming back when party is automated
 Fixed Party Hard 2 keys being given away to first 3 people to leave the "Bug 69" comment right under this announcement

:partydisk: Changes in progress for the next update:

 :partypolice: Detailed user manual on how things work in Tycoon
 :partypills: Better high grade and modifiers balance
 :partymask: Characters and their cost balance
 :PartyEye: Story finale

Have fun!:water:

notes.title: Update: AlienFX support added
notes.content:
What's up, community!

We are here for the quick one: the game has received a minor, but, nevertheless, very important update.:partydisk:Party Hard Tycoon is now a AlienFX-enabled game that has an integrated lighting effect support. That means Alienware users now can adjust their game to have a better pixel-driven experience.

Have fun, everyone!:water:

notes.title: Update: Guest requirement mods, New events, Auto-party, and more
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/7cab8b9ff14533ea1411f73d3af88a4d40637cc6.png
Hello, everyone!

Yes, we admit, it took us too long to finally fulfill our promise. And we know there are no forgiveness for our sins. Try to accept our sincere apologies for the delay and believe us: reasons for this were pretty valid. Now, enough taking your time away, let's summarize new features Party Hard Tycoon has aquired:
[olist]
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/702207d66f7f6c3ad045ea9a15d4b9938eaf59fa.jpg
    [above] Auto-party. You can automatically re-throw your party to repeat the success and organize another party at the same time. This option is available IF the following requirements are met: 
- you haven't changed your trade, equipment and decor items at a certain venue
- you haven't changed the theme of the party
- your party was successful
---------------------------------------------------------------
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/654c15c3a26e9629d16f3383dc2e58ebc16e4116.gif
    [above] Restrooms. People drink and eat stuff at your parties, therefore they need to go sometimes. Be sure your guests have access to toilets at all times. Or... see above.
---------------------------------------------------------------
    https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/fa28b8ff2a6ff0a3ea443014cda1ee3ae4471b27.jpg
[above] Game over screen. Now redesigned. You are given a rank every time you fail. Rank shown in the screenshot above means you did not do very well...
---------------------------------------------------------------
    Smoking areas. Create designated smoking area at your party to avoid complaints from non-smokers.
---------------------------------------------------------------
    Littering. Guests leave trash. Clean the place to avoid complaints from... pretty much everyone.
---------------------------------------------------------------
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/e710d99e56d3b1a5ba7727b00275d96233788d87.png
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/7738477085b3ebeddbb0401aff174965c358d06e.jpg
    [above] More accurate requirements and mods. Green icons indicate guests' expectations, red icons indicate undesirable circumstances.
---------------------------------------------------------------
    Music. It has a bigger impact on your guests. Different equipment will cause different effects that will or won't be suitable for a given party theme.
---------------------------------------------------------------
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/76c2e86a96110bc52f625ce985969e0930a7ac80.jpg
    [above] Updated events. Random party events are more interactive now. Their effects (positive or negative) depends on your decision. 
[/olist]
The update is still somewhat raw, so do not hesitate to report all kinds of issues here, on this community's forums, or via the in-game main menu interface. The game is still in early access state, so there will be more updates and fixes in the future. 

 Have fun, partygoers!:water::partydisk:

notes.title: Huge update coming soon
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/e11d90a0f0e13ae37289d355fb9d0e33ab9581d9.gif

Hello, PH community!

We are assembling a huge Party Hard Tycoon update for you at present. And cannot help but toss a few spoilers your way. Luckily, these are the kind of spoilers you are not ruthlessly brutalized for. So, let's dance:

    In general, people will be more precise in expressing their preferences at parties. 

    http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/47089979d9505eae48821005cd6b14aad01eaa32.gif
[above] Toilet rooms will have a purpose. Except for essential processes in all forms of life, these rooms might be providing a base for other acts. Yuck, smells like smoke!
    http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/560a7f5208ef9ea1c7927a04dfa7f20aa8e023e8.gif
[above] You will be able to designate a space of your choice as a smoking area, so noone wines about how bad the smoke smells. (Beware: smoking is harmful to your [strike]wallet[/strike] health)
    http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/66f98c735ed4acf907d4ac7ccc740b5ed4630b5a.gif
[above] We will add trash that will have to be cleaned up, by you. Why? Because humans are naturally disgusted by garbage and, therefore, will be disappointed by your event. Some people will litter more than others, naturally. Pigs.
    http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/e710d99e56d3b1a5ba7727b00275d96233788d87.png
[above] Each theme will get more accurate requirements. Icons shown in the screenshot above will indicate your visitors' expectations. Green for what they expect, red—for... Cmon, you can see that. Beer for hangover prelude, Cristal for fancy galas, in short.
    Music will have a bigger impact. A speaker, a piano or a DJ controller will cause different effects that will or will not be suitable for a given party theme.
    BBQ and campfiring away indoors will not be a good idea anymore. 
    We have received lots of feedback concerning random events that occur during parties. We listened and now plan to add more of them, but with more player involvement and various gameplay mechanics. You'll have to decide whether to bribe a cop or not, is it a clever idea to let a baseball bat-wielding muscle in, or should your guests try the brand new milk/orange cocktail. 

Well, that about sums it up for now. Please, tell us what you think, guys, as we're always heartily open for the feedback and any incoming suggestions. See you at the party!

P.S. Below is what you deal with when the toilet room is occupied:

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/654c15c3a26e9629d16f3383dc2e58ebc16e4116.gif

notes.title: Big Update and Upcoming Changes
notes.content:
Hey folks! 

We have just updated Party Hard Tycoon and here is a short list of major changes:

 Redesigned calendar system 
Colors of days were too confusing for some players, so we rebuilt this system from scratch. Now venues are not locked to certain calendar days. You still control time progression with it and can see some days with events.

In the next update we will introduce new mechanics regarding locations. We think it will work with the new system just perfectly. We hope it will add more depth to the location management. 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/d3f0a0e7012f298fe65f8c72bf2bf8370eb885e7.png
 
Pre-party 
Now you can refill your tables with drinks and food before the party. 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/e10085a8cb349eeba10831cdbb53d16ce7762232.gif

 Table refill 
We increased waiter refill speed greatly. Also, now he tends to walk only near the tables and doesn`t wander the venue aimlessly.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/0793912fc5a2ebffae7a14b26e8789f8d5c04053.gif
 
People AI 
Now party goers will look for fun instead of checking the fun level on their current spot. 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/7f9c32c9773ee9765ed11141d2d118977d53a6ad.png
 
Interface redesign and fixes 

 Achievements 
This patch should finally fix all major achievement issues. Please,  report if you still have some problems. 


Upcoming changes
Thanks for your feedback, we are preparing really big changes to the game. They will influence all aspects of the game. Expect new, deeper strategy mechanics, redesigned party goer AI and absolutely new purpose of decor. The new update will come shortly. Please,  let us know if you have some ideas you would like to see realized in future updates, we are checking them all!

notes.title: Hotfix Day 2, Party Hard Killer!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/b536d1a38c268f1f1adaca29b41a47f669f269fe.gif
What is up, peeps!

Worked hard to deliver this hot batch of fixes and new features. There goes the change log (EDITED):

    we fixed achievements not unlocking
    we fully fixed the bug when people complained about the lack of music standing in a room full of speakers
    we fixed the lights efficiency not displaying properly
    we partially fixed localization 
    we got rid of some resolution problems and added ultrawide 3440x1440 resolution
    we added gameplay hints
    we added the possibility to see lights & speakers' effect areas during party:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018923/6bb572b0f487f1b50f496d5179b284379e828be5.gif

Darius is here! ːpartyknifeː

Expected him, didn't you? Yes, he is here and loud parties still drive this fellow nuts. To meet him, you have to be on the lookout for the Thrower of the Month: Worst Party contest results. [spoiler]Tip: you can win it by getting the most dislikes. Sounds easy, right? ;-)[/spoiler]

Happy partying, y'all!

notes.title: Launching next week, October 19th!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/W5WUqRh.gif

Good news, party managers! 

Party Hard Tycoon is launching next week in Steam Early Access. You will be able to get your hands on the party management sim on Thursday.

Teaser Trailer
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9f47orno-UM
You should expect a fairly complex business sim where multiple variables can influence the success of your parties. Folks at Pinokl have been working night and day testing and balancing it. We expect to spend about 3 months in Early Access, because Tycoon games can be difficult to balance. 

We're sending out review keys today without embargos, so you will be able to decide for yourselves if the game's worth your time or not. 

See you on the dance floor!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/513330/Party_Hard_Tycoon/
